scope: Actual released LibPack Qt 6.11.1 baseline diagnostics from native Windows execution and Linux PDF inspection; metadata-only retention of original receipts, without SDK/DLL bytes.

verification.sdk_archive_authentication: Native generator checked the entire downloaded SDK archive against the pinned official asset size and SHA-256 before extraction. This receipt retains that authenticated native result; it does not redistribute or locally rehash SDK archive/DLL bytes.
verification.runtime_authentication: Native Windows IsWow64Process2, actual loaded-module enumeration, SDK-relative file SHA-256, PE machine and file-version checks. Transported origin/hash/PE receipts were checked against unchanged full SDK inventories.
verification.operator_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=true and separators comma/colon. Operator sequences contain decoded operator plus compare.py stable_operand(operands); normalized sequence removes only bare invalid coordinate-free h/f pairs.
verification.raster_hash_format: SHA-256 of original Poppler PNG bytes and separately decoded RGBA bytes, at 100 dpi. Linux CI rendered the original native PDFs; local review rechecked original PNG bytes/pixels without rerendering.
